_about: Coin series read as sources (D-151): which CRRO types to take from the dump (crro/nomisma.rdf, ODbL 1.0), the Work that is the series' own voice, and the force its named units are proposed as part of (curator, 2026-11-15). Read by harvest/crro_coins.py.

work.label: Mark Antony, legionary coinage (RRC 544)
work.description: Denarii and aurei struck for Mark Antony in 32–31 BC, each reverse naming a legion or cohort of his army; catalogued as Crawford, Roman Republican Coinage 544.

force.label: Antony's land forces, 32–31 BC
force.description: The legions and cohorts of Mark Antony's army in the war of 32–30 BC, before and around Actium; not limited to the battle.

series.unitDescription: A {kind} of Mark Antony's army, named on his legionary coinage of 32–31 BC (RRC 544).

work.label: Pinarius Scarpus, coinage of Cyrenaica (RRC 546)
work.description: Denarii, an aureus and a quinarius struck by L. Pinarius Scarpus in Cyrenaica in 31 BC: first for Mark Antony (M ANTO COS III IMP IIII; SCARPVS IMP; one naming LEG VIII), then for Octavian (IMP CAESAR DIVI F; SCARPVS IMP); catalogued as Crawford, Roman Republican Coinage 546.

force.label: Antony's land forces, 32–31 BC
force.description: The legions and cohorts of Mark Antony's army in the war of 32–30 BC, before and around Actium; not limited to the battle.

series.unitDescription: A {kind} of Mark Antony's army under his legate Pinarius Scarpus in Cyrenaica, named on Scarpus's coinage of 31 BC (RRC 546).
